body:
Founder real-time: continue DUNG, ensure artifacts+bazel builds once we have an entrypoint, then try to write the entry in parena. Root-caused the real cgo/pkg-config gap: gazelle never invokes pkg-config generating go_repository BUILD files and doesn't reliably translate #cgo CFLAGS/LDFLAGS either. Fixed via a hand-authored sdl/BUILD.bazel (real pkg-config values inlined) + gazelle generation off for that module, applied as a diff-generated patch. bazel build //... succeeds (54 actions); ran the real bazel-bin binary under Xvfb, verified identical correct rendering to the plain-go-build proof. Separately: ported two real scalar decision-logic pieces (split-size, next-focus-index) from main.go into real PARENA source -- burrow parse/analyze/build all clean, gcc-verified against real assertions. Found the precise next boundary via a deliberate probe: defstruct parses/region-analyzes but burrow build rejects it at the top-level-form dispatch stage -- fed back into BURROW/NORTHSTAR.md. DUNG commit e1dea0b, BURROW commit fc706c4.

⚓ ☃
title: DUNG — real bazel build succeeds; first real PARENA entry attempt
